issuing_authority: Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat dan Presiden Republik Indonesia
title_original: Undang-Undang Republik Indonesia Nomor 40 Tahun 2004 tentang Sistem Jaminan Sosial Nasional
title_english: Law No. 40 Year 2004 on the National Social Security System (UU SJSN)
summary: Foundational statute establishing the principles of mandatory social security, mutual cooperation (gotong royong), non-profit operation, and universal health security for all residents of Indonesia.
key_provisions: Pasal 19: Health security is implemented on the principle of social insurance and equity, ensuring comprehensive medical benefits.
Pasal 22: Health security benefits are intended to maintain and enhance the health degree of participants and their family members.
applicable_population: Foreigners residing and working for at least 6 months

title_original: Peraturan Presiden Nomor 59 Tahun 2024 tentang Perubahan Ketiga atas Peraturan Presiden Nomor 82 Tahun 2018 tentang Jaminan Kesehatan
title_english: Presidential Regulation No. 59 Year 2024 on Health Security (Perpres JKN 2024)
summary: Regulates the implementation of Standard Inpatient Classes (Kelas Rawat Inap Standar - KRIS), service referral mechanisms, contribution tiers, and comprehensive list of excluded medical procedures under JKN BPJS Kesehatan.
key_provisions: Pasal 46: Implementation of KRIS minimum hospital facility criteria across all participating JKN partner hospitals.
Pasal 52: Exhaustive statutory exclusions list from JKN benefits (aesthetic surgery, non-referral non-emergencies, overseas care, injuries from intoxication).
applicable_population: Healthcare provider facilities (FKTP and FKRTL) in Indonesia

title_original: Peraturan Otoritas Jasa Keuangan Nomor 22 Tahun 2023 tentang Pelindungan Konsumen dan Masyarakat di Sektor Jasa Keuangan
title_english: OJK Regulation No. 22 Year 2023 on Consumer Protection in Financial Services (POJK 22/2023)
summary: Mandates transparency, fair treatment, clear policy wording disclosure (RIPLAY), and internal dispute resolution standards for licensed insurance companies operating in Indonesia.
key_provisions: Pasal 14: Insurers must deliver accurate, balanced, and understandable Product and Service Information Summary (RIPLAY) prior to policy contracting.
Pasal 38: Financial service businesses must handle consumer complaints within a maximum of 10 working days (extendable by 10 working days for complex cases).
applicable_population: Licensed commercial insurance companies in Indonesia

issuing_authority: Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat dan Presiden Republik Indonesia
title_original: Undang-Undang Republik Indonesia Nomor 27 Tahun 2022 tentang Pelindungan Data Pribadi
title_english: Law No. 27 Year 2022 on Personal Data Protection (UU PDP)
summary: Indonesia's comprehensive data privacy statute, defining health data, biometrics, and personal financial data as Specific Personal Data requiring explicit consent and high-standard data governance.
key_provisions: Pasal 4 ayat (2): Health data and information, genetic data, and personal financial data are Specific Personal Data (Data Pribadi yang Bersifat Spesifik).
Pasal 20: Processing of personal data requires valid legal basis, including explicit consent from the data subject for specified purposes.
applicable_population: Data controllers and data processors handling personal data of Indonesian residents
